text:
Aisha Patel: Weekly health check for Novaton (private VPC) — quick snapshot: usage up 12% w/w, overall spend +18% (mainly tokens in staging). Latency regressions noted in ap-south.
Marc Delgado: Thanks — can you drop the region-by-region numbers?
Aisha Patel: Sure. Uptime: us-west-2 99.99%, eu-west-1 99.95%, ap-south-1 99.6%. 5xx error rate: eu-west spike ~0.9% yesterday (normally 0.05%). Avg gen latency: us-west 85ms, eu-west 120ms, ap-south 260ms.
Lei Chen: ap-south 260ms is high — are they on the quantized variant or full fp16?
Aisha Patel: They're on rdx-large-8q by default. We saw a KV cache miss storm during a staging load test, which bumped token counts and pushed latency up.
Ravi Narayanan: Also saw several KMS timeouts in eu-west between 03:10–03:22 UTC yesterday, correlates with the 5xx spike. KMS error logs: `ERROR KMS_CLIENT: connection timeout` repeated.
Lei Chen: Noted. I kicked off a quick remediation yesterday — retried a subset with fallback KMS endpoint and saw success. Looking into circuit-breaker thresholds.
Marc Delgado: Any planned HSM maintenance windows coming up? Novaton asked about key rotation and HSM-backed signing for compliance.
Aisha Patel: Customer requested HSM integration doc and a runbook. No maintenance scheduled from our side, but eu-west HSM provider announced a patch next Tuesday 02:00–04:00 UTC. I flagged potential risk for rollout.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Canary: kms-fallback-config deployed to eu-west-1 at 1987654380 — monitoring.
Aisha Patel: After canary, error rate dropped to ~0.12% in the next 20m. We should still plan a follow-up: Marc to run an enablement session for Novaton on Thurs 11am PT, Lei to prepare runbook + HSM doc. @Marc @Lei please confirm.
Marc Delgado: Confirmed, I'll host the session and capture outstanding questions. I'll include latency tuning notes (batching/cache TTLs). :thumbsup:
Lei Chen: I'll draft runbook and share by EOD Wednesday. Will include `kms-fallback` config snippet and rollback steps. Example snippet:```yaml
kms:
  primary_endpoint: kms.eu-west-1.redwood.internal
  fallback_endpoint: kms.eu-west-1.fallback
  timeout_ms: 1500
  max_retries: 3
```
Ravi Narayanan: Renewal update: Novaton is on an annual retainer expiring in 6 weeks. Usage trending up overall (good), but the ap-south latency note + recent spend spike are potential objections. Recommend a 1:1 with exec sponsor to lock renewal — Aisha can you lead?
Aisha Patel: I can. I'll propose a short optimization plan (cache tuning + HSM runbook + scheduled enablement) and a modest credit for the staging overage to smooth the renewal convo.
Marc Delgado: Also capture feedback: Novaton asked for a post-deploy checklist for KMS/HSM and clearer APAC region performance targets. I'll add to the slide deck.
Aisha Patel: Next steps recap: 1) Lei — runbook + HSM doc by EOD Wed. 2) Marc — enablement session Thurs 11am PT + slides. 3) Lei/Eng — monitor ap-south perf, try aggressive prefix caching for a 48h test. 4) Ravi/Aisha — schedule exec renewal touchpoint next week.
Lei Chen: On it. I'll open a short incident ticket to track ap-south perf test and attach results to the runbook.
Ravi Narayanan: Thanks all. I'll prep the renewal brief with spend trends and mitigation plan.
Aisha Patel: Thanks team — will update thread after Thu session. :sparkles:
